messages:
anya (Product): Heads up — we need to lock launch acceptance for RollForward by next Wed. High-level targets: p99 latency < 300ms, cost goal ~ $0.003/token for steady state. I want a quick owner/dep map and any hard blockers.
mike (Eng Runtime): Needs: KV cache warmup hook + batching window tweak. I think runtime changes are ~2 sprints if we do it clean. Can we relax cost target for beta to avoid a risky optimization? :thinking_face:
lisa (Infra): For dedicated canary we should reserve 4x A100 for the week of launch. Finance sign-off required. Also network egress rules for the customer VPC will need a firewall exception. I can request capacity but need firm dates.
raj (Security): From security side, main ask is dataflow diagram + PII filter proof. If the customer is on Private, we need KMS integration validated. Threat model review by next Tue to hit Wed launch.
thomas (Product): Customer success expects SLA 99.9 for Dedicated customers. If we can’t meet that, we need to set correct expectations or delay dedicated support.
anya (Product): Ok — compressed owners: runtime=mike, infra=lisa, security=raj, SRE=priya, product=anya/thomas. If any owner can't commit, propose fallback plans now.
mike (Eng Runtime): I'm ok to own runtime changes but will feature-flag them. Prototype plan: change batching window and add KV prewarm hook behind flag. Rough code sample to discuss:
```python
# runtime config change (feature-flagged)
runtime.flags['rf_batch_window_ms'] = 16
runtime.hooks.register('kv_prewarm', prewarm_fn)
```
I'll aim for a feature branch within 6 business days.
lisa (Infra): I'll request the dedicated slots. If Finance denies, fallback is burst-on-hosted + autoscale with a hard rate limit at gateway. That will increase p99 a bit but keeps availability.
priya (SRE): Suggest adding a canary rollout: 1% -> 10% -> 50% with automated rollback on error-rate or latency regressions. I can own the alert runbooks and the rollback playbook.
raj (Security): Quick note: for the Private deployment customers we need KMS proof and audit logs retention policy. I'll need the threat model by Tue to give final sign-off. Also require an S3 bucket lifecycle doc for logs.
thomas (Product): Re: launch criteria — we must pass: (1) perf test p99 <300ms on canary, (2) rollback within 15m, (3) security signoff for dataflows, (4) infra commit for capacity or documented fallback. Agree?
anya (Product): Yes. Action items: mike - confirm branch by Fri EOD; lisa - capacity request ticket + expected approval date; raj - threat model slot; priya - runbooks + canary hooks. If any owner misses EOD Fri we'll schedule a 30m triage Mon.
deploy-bot: canary cluster created: canary-rf-3 (region us-west2) :white_check_mark:
mike (Eng Runtime): FYI I'll add telemetry tags so SRE can slice by canary vs prod. Example tag `rollforward_experiment=true`.
lisa (Infra): Ticket filed: INFRA-3129, requested 4x A100 for 2025-03-10 to 2025-03-17. Marking tentative until finance ok.
raj (Security): Slot booked for threat review: 2025-03-04 11:00 PT. Invites sent.
thomas (Product): Good progress. If anything slips, propose we soft-launch hosted-only with a smaller model and explicit customer opt-in.
anya (Product): Final: owners confirm by EOD Fri. I'll send a brief summary to execs after confirmations. :thumbsup:
mike (Eng Runtime): Confirmed — will have branch and basic tests by Fri.
lisa (Infra): Confirmed — capacity request filed; will update when finance replies.
raj (Security): Confirmed — threat model slot reserved.
priya (SRE): Confirmed — runbook draft in shared doc, will push final by Fri EOD.
anya (Product): Thanks all — closing this thread. We'll reconvene Mon if any open items.
